default: Personal injury claimants in Arizona can recover various types of compensation, including:

default.title: Economic Damages
default.description: To cover quantifiable losses such as medical expenses, lost wages, and property damage.

default.title: Non-economic Damages
default.description: To compensate for subjective, non-monetary losses like pain, suffering, and emotional distress.

default.title: Punitive Damages
default.description: In some cases, a court may award you punitive damages if the at-fault party's conduct was particularly egregious, serving as a punishment and deterrent for such behavior.

default: Also, Arizona follows a comparative negligence rule (A.R.S. § 12-2505), meaning you can still recover damages even if you are partially at fault. However, the amount may be reduced by your percentage of fault.
